facts.heading: Tomas is nervous about therapy
facts.content: Tomas stated he is quite nervous about attending therapy.
facts.evidence: I am quite nervous, if I am honest.

facts.heading: Wife suggested seeking therapy
facts.content: Tomas's wife suggested he seek therapy because the current situation 'can't go on'.
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove 30 times.
facts.evidence: I check 30 times if I locked the door and turned off the stove.

facts.heading: Time spent leaving apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour before he leaves the apartment.
facts.evidence: It takes me an hour before I leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Anxiety triggers fire image
facts.content: When Tomas checks, he gets anxious, and an image of him having to burn comes to his head.
facts.evidence: I get anxious. Then an image comes to my head that I didn't do it properly and I have to burn.

facts.heading: Fire image is vivid
facts.content: Tomas sees the image of being in flames clearly, like a film.
facts.evidence: Being in flames. I see it clearly like a film.

facts.heading: Compulsions happen daily
facts.content: The anxious images happen to Tomas every day.
facts.evidence: Every day.

facts.heading: Compulsions worse at certain times
facts.content: The compulsions are worst in the evening when going out or to sleep, and in the morning too.
facts.evidence: It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep. And in the morning too.

facts.heading: Onset linked to neighbor's fire
facts.content: The issue started two years ago after the neighbor's house caught fire and they evacuated.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbor's house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Details of neighbor's fire
facts.content: The fire happened at night, with an alarm, smoke in the hallway, and people screaming.
facts.evidence: It was at night. Then there was an alarm, there was smoke in the hallway, and people were screaming.

facts.heading: Tomas felt sense of responsibility
facts.content: After the fire, Tomas felt he could cause it, and that if he didn't control something, it would happen and he would be responsible.
facts.evidence: At that time, I have the feeling that I can cause it. That if I don't control something, it will happen and I will be responsible.

facts.heading: Wife is aware of the issue
facts.content: Tomas's wife, Barbara, knows about the issue.
facts.evidence: Barbara. My wife.

facts.heading: Wife sees issue is more than habit
facts.content: Barbara now sees that Tomas's behavior is more than just a habit.
facts.evidence: At first she took it as a habit, now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Wife's exhaustion from issue
facts.content: Tomas observes that his wife is exhausted by the issue.
facts.evidence: I see that it exhausts her.

facts.heading: Late arrival at cinema
facts.content: Tomas arrived at the cinema 40 minutes late yesterday.
facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema 40 minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction at cinema
facts.content: Barbara waited outside for Tomas, and the argument ended after the third look from her.
facts.evidence: She waited outside for me to come back and the argument ended after the third.

facts.heading: Tomas felt like a child
facts.content: Tomas felt like a child who can't leave the house.
facts.evidence: I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.heading: Job as an electrician in Malomolec
facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Malomolec. He performs wiring in apartments and houses.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Malomolec. I do wiring in apartments and sometimes in houses.

facts.heading: Concerns about making mistakes
facts.content: Tomas worries about making a mistake that could lead to flooding or damage.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head, I might make a mistake, that I might fall into a flood or something get damaged.

facts.heading: Checks on ongoing jobs
facts.content: Tomas goes back to ongoing jobs the next day just to look and check.
facts.evidence: But I go back for checks on ongoing jobs. Just when I go back the next day, just to look.

facts.heading: Boss calls him careful
facts.content: Tomas's boss tells him he is the most careful in the company.
facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company

facts.heading: Work slowing down recently
facts.content: In the last few months, Tomas's work has slowed down by an hour per day.
facts.evidence: In the last few months, the work has slowed down by an hour per day.

facts.heading: Fear of losing job
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he will lose his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Partner is pregnant in fourth month
facts.content: Tomas's partner, Probora, is pregnant in her fourth month.
facts.evidence: Probora is pregnant in the fourth month.

facts.heading: Waited three years for child
facts.content: Tomas and his partner waited three years for the child.
facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years

facts.heading: Intrusive thoughts about harm
facts.content: Tomas has thoughts that it would harm his partner and the baby.
facts.evidence: That it would harm her and the baby.

facts.heading: Thoughts occur while cutting bread
facts.content: The thought comes when Tomas is cutting bread on the landing.
facts.evidence: But the thought comes when I'm cutting bread on the landing

facts.heading: Worst when not told anyone
facts.content: Tomas finds it worst when he hasn't told anyone about the thoughts, not even Barbora.
facts.evidence: It's the worst when I haven't told anyone. Not even Barbora.

facts.heading: Leaves room when thought appears
facts.content: When the thought appears, Tomas leaves the room.
facts.evidence: I leave the room.

facts.heading: Checking helps calm thoughts
facts.content: Tomas checks something to make the thought stop, which helps calm him.
facts.evidence: Or I come back and check something to make it stop.

facts.heading: Sleeps intermittently at night
facts.content: Tomas sleeps intermittently and gets up twice at night to check sporadically.
facts.evidence: I sleep intermittently. I get up twice at night and check sporadically

facts.heading: Walks with Barbara weekly
facts.content: Tomas goes for walks with Barbara about twice a week when there is something going on at home.
facts.evidence: Walks twice. A week. Well, just about.

facts.heading: Goal to leave woods in five minutes
facts.content: Tomas's goal is to be able to leave the woods in five minutes.
facts.evidence: To leave the woods in five minutes.

facts.heading: Goal to look forward to child
facts.content: Tomas's goal is to look forward to a child without those thoughts.
facts.evidence: And to look forward to a child without those thoughts.

facts.heading: Fear of exposure therapy
facts.content: Tomas was afraid of therapy where a person gradually exposes themselves to what they are afraid of.
facts.evidence: I was afraid of that.

facts.heading: Fear of being forced to leave door
facts.content: Tomas feared someone would force him to leave the door open.
facts.evidence: I thought someone would force me to leave the door open.

facts.heading: Difficulty with small steps
facts.content: Tomas feels that the small step of checking the door once is big for him.
facts.evidence: It sounds small, but it is big for me.

facts.heading: Feelings for Barbora
facts.content: Tomas wants to tell Barbora that he loves her and has not lost interest in her.
facts.evidence: That I love her. And that I haven't lost my interest in her.

facts.heading: Fear of Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas is afraid that Barbora would not want to be with him.
facts.evidence: Right now I'm afraid she wouldn't want to be with me.

facts.heading: Belief about Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas believes Barbora would hug him.
facts.evidence: She would hug me. That's how she is.

facts.heading: Attempt to try door check
facts.content: Tomas agreed to try checking the door just once when leaving the apartment.
facts.evidence: Once. I'll try it.

facts.heading: Plan to write down number
facts.content: Tomas plans to write down a number from one to ten.
facts.evidence: And I'll write down a number from one to ten.
